datasets.name: ovd_kpi
queryLines:
WITH cal AS (SELECT report_date, previous_date, previous_month_date, previous_year_date
             FROM gold_serving.overdue_report_calendar WHERE report_date <= :report_date),
cur AS (SELECT c.report_date, c.previous_date, c.previous_month_date, c.previous_year_date,
               (SELECT max_by(rate_to_vnd, rate_date) FROM silver.ref_fx_rates WHERE currencycd = 'USD' AND rate_date <= :report_date) AS usd
        FROM cal c WHERE c.report_date = (SELECT max(report_date) FROM cal))
, per AS (
  SELECT stack(4, 0, 'CURRENT', 'Current', report_date,
                  1, 'D1', 'vs Last Day', previous_date,
                  2, 'M1', 'vs Last Month', previous_month_date,
                  3, 'Y1', 'vs Last Year', previous_year_date) AS (ord, period, cmp, d)
  FROM cur),
v AS (
SELECT f.as_of_date, sum(f.ovd_bal) AS ovd, sum(f.port_bal) AS port
FROM gold_serving.card_mart_overdue_daily f JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT d FROM per WHERE d IS NOT NULL) x ON f.as_of_date = x.d
WHERE (:branch = 'all' OR f.mng_br = :branch)
GROUP BY f.as_of_date),
k AS (
  SELECT per.ord, per.period, per.cmp, per.d AS actual_date, v.port AS port_bal, v.ovd AS ovd_bal,
         v.ovd / nullif(v.port, 0) * 100 AS overdue_ratio,
         v.ovd / cur.usd AS overdue_usd, v.port / cur.usd AS ending_balance_usd, cur.usd
  FROM per CROSS JOIN cur LEFT JOIN v ON v.as_of_date = per.d)
SELECT actual_date, usd AS fx_vnd_usd, overdue_ratio, overdue_usd,
       ending_balance_usd AS ending_usd
FROM k WHERE period = 'CURRENT'

datasets.name: ovd_compare
datasets.displayName: KPI vs Last Day / Month / Year
queryLines:
WITH cal AS (SELECT report_date, previous_date, previous_month_date, previous_year_date
             FROM gold_serving.overdue_report_calendar WHERE report_date <= :report_date),
cur AS (SELECT c.report_date, c.previous_date, c.previous_month_date, c.previous_year_date,
               (SELECT max_by(rate_to_vnd, rate_date) FROM silver.ref_fx_rates WHERE currencycd = 'USD' AND rate_date <= :report_date) AS usd
        FROM cal c WHERE c.report_date = (SELECT max(report_date) FROM cal))
, per AS (
  SELECT stack(4, 0, 'CURRENT', 'Current', report_date,
                  1, 'D1', 'vs Last Day', previous_date,
                  2, 'M1', 'vs Last Month', previous_month_date,
                  3, 'Y1', 'vs Last Year', previous_year_date) AS (ord, period, cmp, d)
  FROM cur),
v AS (
SELECT f.as_of_date, sum(f.ovd_bal) AS ovd, sum(f.port_bal) AS port
FROM gold_serving.card_mart_overdue_daily f JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT d FROM per WHERE d IS NOT NULL) x ON f.as_of_date = x.d
WHERE (:branch = 'all' OR f.mng_br = :branch)
GROUP BY f.as_of_date),
k AS (
  SELECT per.ord, per.period, per.cmp, per.d AS actual_date, v.port AS port_bal, v.ovd AS ovd_bal,
         v.ovd / nullif(v.port, 0) * 100 AS overdue_ratio,
         v.ovd / cur.usd AS overdue_usd, v.port / cur.usd AS ending_balance_usd, cur.usd
  FROM per CROSS JOIN cur LEFT JOIN v ON v.as_of_date = per.d)
, c AS (SELECT * FROM k WHERE period = 'CURRENT')
SELECT k.ord, k.period, k.actual_date,
       concat(k.cmp, ' (', coalesce(date_format(k.actual_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'N/A'), ')') AS cmp,
       round(c.overdue_ratio - k.overdue_ratio, 2) AS ratio_pp,
       round(c.overdue_usd - k.overdue_usd, 0) AS overdue_usd,
       round(c.ending_balance_usd - k.ending_balance_usd, 0) AS ending_usd,
       CASE WHEN round(c.overdue_ratio - k.overdue_ratio, 2) IS NULL THEN 'N/A' ELSE concat(CASE WHEN round(c.overdue_ratio - k.overdue_ratio, 2) > 0 THEN '▲ ' WHEN round(c.overdue_ratio - k.overdue_ratio, 2) < 0 THEN '▼ ' ELSE '▪ ' END, format_number(abs(round(c.overdue_ratio - k.overdue_ratio, 2)), 2), ' pp') END AS ratio_txt,
       CASE WHEN round(c.overdue_usd - k.overdue_usd, 0) IS NULL THEN 'N/A' ELSE concat(CASE WHEN round(c.overdue_usd - k.overdue_usd, 0) > 0 THEN '▲ ' WHEN round(c.overdue_usd - k.overdue_usd, 0) < 0 THEN '▼ ' ELSE '▪ ' END, format_number(abs(round(c.overdue_usd - k.overdue_usd, 0)), 0), '') END AS overdue_txt,
       CASE WHEN round(c.ending_balance_usd - k.ending_balance_usd, 0) IS NULL THEN 'N/A' ELSE concat(CASE WHEN round(c.ending_balance_usd - k.ending_balance_usd, 0) > 0 THEN '▲ ' WHEN round(c.ending_balance_usd - k.ending_balance_usd, 0) < 0 THEN '▼ ' ELSE '▪ ' END, format_number(abs(round(c.ending_balance_usd - k.ending_balance_usd, 0)), 0), '') END AS ending_txt
FROM k CROSS JOIN c WHERE k.period <> 'CURRENT'
ORDER BY k.ord

datasets.name: ovd_daily_trend
queryLines:
WITH cal AS (SELECT report_date, previous_date, previous_month_date, previous_year_date
             FROM gold_serving.overdue_report_calendar WHERE report_date <= :report_date),
cur AS (SELECT c.report_date, c.previous_date, c.previous_month_date, c.previous_year_date,
               (SELECT max_by(rate_to_vnd, rate_date) FROM silver.ref_fx_rates WHERE currencycd = 'USD' AND rate_date <= :report_date) AS usd
        FROM cal c WHERE c.report_date = (SELECT max(report_date) FROM cal))
, dd AS (SELECT c.report_date AS d FROM cal c ORDER BY c.report_date DESC LIMIT 5),
v AS (
SELECT f.as_of_date, sum(f.ovd_bal) AS ovd, sum(f.port_bal) AS port
FROM gold_serving.card_mart_overdue_daily f JOIN dd x ON f.as_of_date = x.d
WHERE (:branch = 'all' OR f.mng_br = :branch)
GROUP BY f.as_of_date)
SELECT date_format(dd.d, 'MM-dd') AS day, dd.d AS actual_date,
       v.ovd / cur.usd / 1000 AS overdue_k_usd,
       v.ovd / nullif(v.port, 0) * 100 AS overdue_ratio
FROM dd CROSS JOIN cur LEFT JOIN v ON v.as_of_date = dd.d
ORDER BY dd.d

datasets.name: ovd_monthly_trend
queryLines:
WITH cal AS (SELECT report_date, previous_date, previous_month_date, previous_year_date
             FROM gold_serving.overdue_report_calendar WHERE report_date <= :report_date),
cur AS (SELECT c.report_date, c.previous_date, c.previous_month_date, c.previous_year_date,
               (SELECT max_by(rate_to_vnd, rate_date) FROM silver.ref_fx_rates WHERE currencycd = 'USD' AND rate_date <= :report_date) AS usd
        FROM cal c WHERE c.report_date = (SELECT max(report_date) FROM cal))
, m AS (SELECT max(c.report_date) AS d FROM cal c, cur
        WHERE c.report_date > last_day(add_months(cur.report_date, -6)) GROUP BY date_trunc('MONTH', c.report_date))
, v AS (
SELECT f.as_of_date, sum(f.ovd_bal) AS ovd, sum(f.port_bal) AS port
FROM gold_serving.card_mart_overdue_daily f JOIN m x ON f.as_of_date = x.d
WHERE (:branch = 'all' OR f.mng_br = :branch)
GROUP BY f.as_of_date)
SELECT date_format(m.d, 'yyyy-MM') AS month, m.d AS actual_date,
       v.ovd / cur.usd / 1000 AS overdue_k_usd,
       v.ovd / nullif(v.port, 0) * 100 AS overdue_ratio
FROM m CROSS JOIN cur LEFT JOIN v ON v.as_of_date = m.d
ORDER BY m.d

datasets.name: ovd_debt_groups
queryLines:
WITH cal AS (SELECT report_date, previous_date, previous_month_date, previous_year_date
             FROM gold_serving.overdue_report_calendar WHERE report_date <= :report_date),
cur AS (SELECT c.report_date, c.previous_date, c.previous_month_date, c.previous_year_date,
               (SELECT max_by(rate_to_vnd, rate_date) FROM silver.ref_fx_rates WHERE currencycd = 'USD' AND rate_date <= :report_date) AS usd
        FROM cal c WHERE c.report_date = (SELECT max(report_date) FROM cal))
, m AS (SELECT max(c.report_date) AS d FROM cal c, cur
        WHERE year(c.report_date) = year(cur.report_date) GROUP BY date_trunc('MONTH', c.report_date))
, v AS (
SELECT f.as_of_date, f.del_grp, sum(f.ovd_bal) AS ovd, sum(f.port_bal) AS port
FROM gold_serving.card_mart_overdue_daily f JOIN m x ON f.as_of_date = x.d
WHERE (:branch = 'all' OR f.mng_br = :branch)
GROUP BY f.as_of_date, f.del_grp)
SELECT date_format(v.as_of_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS month, v.as_of_date AS actual_date,
       v.del_grp, v.ovd / cur.usd / 1000 AS overdue_k_usd
FROM v CROSS JOIN cur
WHERE v.del_grp <> '0'
ORDER BY month, v.del_grp

datasets.name: ovd_product
queryLines:
WITH cal AS (SELECT report_date, previous_date, previous_month_date, previous_year_date
             FROM gold_serving.overdue_report_calendar WHERE report_date <= :report_date),
cur AS (SELECT c.report_date, c.previous_date, c.previous_month_date, c.previous_year_date,
               (SELECT max_by(rate_to_vnd, rate_date) FROM silver.ref_fx_rates WHERE currencycd = 'USD' AND rate_date <= :report_date) AS usd
        FROM cal c WHERE c.report_date = (SELECT max(report_date) FROM cal))
, v AS (
SELECT f.as_of_date, coalesce(f.product_group, 'Other') AS pg, sum(f.ovd_bal) AS ovd, sum(f.port_bal) AS port
FROM gold_serving.card_mart_overdue_daily f JOIN (SELECT report_date AS d FROM cur) x ON f.as_of_date = x.d

FROM v CROSS JOIN cur

datasets.name: ovd_product_top5
datasets.displayName: Overdue Ratio by Product Groups - Top5
queryLines:
WITH cal AS (SELECT report_date, previous_date, previous_month_date, previous_year_date
             FROM gold_serving.overdue_report_calendar WHERE report_date <= :report_date),
cur AS (SELECT c.report_date, c.previous_date, c.previous_month_date, c.previous_year_date,
               (SELECT max_by(rate_to_vnd, rate_date) FROM silver.ref_fx_rates WHERE currencycd = 'USD' AND rate_date <= :report_date) AS usd
        FROM cal c WHERE c.report_date = (SELECT max(report_date) FROM cal))
, v AS (
SELECT f.as_of_date, coalesce(f.product_group, 'Other') AS pg, sum(f.ovd_bal) AS ovd, sum(f.port_bal) AS port
FROM gold_serving.card_mart_overdue_daily f JOIN (SELECT report_date AS d FROM cur) x ON f.as_of_date = x.d
WHERE (:branch = 'all' OR f.mng_br = :branch)

datasets.name: ovd_branch_top5
queryLines:
WITH cal AS (SELECT report_date, previous_date, previous_month_date, previous_year_date
             FROM gold_serving.overdue_report_calendar WHERE report_date <= :report_date),
cur AS (SELECT c.report_date, c.previous_date, c.previous_month_date, c.previous_year_date,
               (SELECT max_by(rate_to_vnd, rate_date) FROM silver.ref_fx_rates WHERE currencycd = 'USD' AND rate_date <= :report_date) AS usd
        FROM cal c WHERE c.report_date = (SELECT max(report_date) FROM cal))
, v AS (
SELECT f.as_of_date, f.mng_br, sum(f.ovd_bal) AS ovd, sum(f.port_bal) AS port
FROM gold_serving.card_mart_overdue_daily f JOIN (SELECT report_date AS d FROM cur) x ON f.as_of_date = x.d
WHERE (:branch = 'all' OR f.mng_br = :branch)
GROUP BY f.as_of_date, f.mng_br)
SELECT v.mng_br AS branch, v.ovd / cur.usd AS overdue_usd,
       v.ovd / cur.usd / 1000 AS overdue_k_usd,
       v.ovd / nullif(v.port, 0) * 100 AS overdue_ratio
FROM v CROSS JOIN cur
WHERE v.mng_br <> '8125' AND v.ovd / cur.usd > 10000
ORDER BY overdue_ratio DESC, branch LIMIT 5

datasets.name: ovd_branch_options
queryLines:
SELECT 'all' AS branch UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT mng_br FROM gold_serving.card_mart_overdue_daily
WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT max(report_date) FROM gold_serving.overdue_report_calendar) AND mng_br IS NOT NULL
